overview_description.description:
Segment provides the customer data infrastructure that helps businesses put their customers first. Using Segment, companies can collect, unify, and connect their first-party to over 200 marketing, analytics, and data warehouse tools.

It was founded in 2011 and headquartered in San Francisco, California.

about_short_description.short_description: Segment provides customer data infrastructure that helps businesses put their customers first.

product.name: Twilio Segment Customer Data Platform (CDP)
product.description: A cloud-based platform that collects, unifies, and activates customer data from multiple sources to create unified customer profiles for real-time insights and personalized engagement.

product.name: Generative AI Solutions
product.description: AI tools that create targeted audiences and launch personalized customer journeys using simple text prompts for scalable 1:1 interactions.

product.name: Predictive AI Solutions
product.description: AI models that predict customer behavior to build targeted audiences and personalized campaigns that reduce costs and improve conversion rates.

product.name: Data Integration and Activation Services
product.description: Services that collect data from various sources, unify it into customer profiles, and activate it across tools via 450+ pre-built connectors.

identifier.value: Reverse ETL and Warehouse Data Activation

product.name: Reverse ETL and Warehouse Data Activation
product.description: A zero-copy architecture that treats data warehouses as the source of truth, enabling real-time enrichment and activation of customer data across teams and applications.
